text:
Sam G: Quick heads-up — planning to push kernel-quant v3.2-staging to the night bucket at 22:00 UTC. No infra changes. Need: pinned image digest, release note bullets, and a rollback gate.

deploybot: deploy scheduled: image=registry.redwood.io/engine:kernel-quant-v3.2-staging@sha256:abc123 -> target=staging; window=22:00-23:30 UTC; notify=#eng-runtime; canary=10% -> 50% -> 100%

Anika (PM): Adding release note bullets: "+5% median perf (seq512)", "fix cold KV warmup regressions", "quant fallback toggle exposed". Will draft short blurb for release notes page.

Lee: I uploaded the signed digest to `build-artifacts/kq/v3.2/staging.digest` and the smoke script to `infra/smoke/kq_v3_2.sh`. Ran quick local smoke on a x4 GPU staging node — no OOMs, perf looks fine on seq128/512.

Matt (oncall): Leaving the night holdback for Dedicated — can we pin v3.1 on dedicated pools until we confirm metrics? Also set rollback triggers: p95 latency +8% vs baseline OR error rate >0.5% OR any OOMs in telemetry.

Sam G: Agree on pin for Dedicated. Can we have the rollout as: 10% -> 30% after 10m -> 100% after 30m if signals OK? Manual pause before 100%.

Lee: deploybot config updated to: `canary=[10,30]; pause_before_100=true; metrics_window=300s`. I also added a quick guard in runtime to opt out quant path via `--quant-fallback=on` if we see unexpected token degradation.

opsbot: preflight checks: all artifacts present, signature OK, infra quota OK, monitor hooks registered.

deploybot: executing: step=canary-10pct -> started.

Anika (PM): Heads-up to support and docs: small note about the fallback toggle and the perf wins. Keeping the rollout notes in the release doc at `confluence/runtimes/release-notes/kq-3.2`.

(11 minutes pass)

deploybot: telemetry update: canary=10% complete. metrics: p50:+3%, p95:+12% (slice=kv-hot), errors: +0.2%.

Matt (oncall): Seeing a p95 spike concentrated to connections hitting cold-KV paths (slice=kv-hot). Is this expected from v3.2 heuristics?

Lee: I saw that in internal bench — there was a small regression for cold KV warmup in the quant path. I pushed a microfix branch earlier but didn't bake it into this staging image.

Sam G: Given p95 > our +8% threshold, let's pause and pin staging back to v3.1 for the night. Also initiate rollback plan and pin dedicated pools to v3.1.

deploybot: initiating canary abort and rollback: current -> kernel-quant-v3.1@sha256:def456; rollback started. Notifying #eng-runtime.

opsbot: rollback completed on staging at 22:18 UTC. All nodes converged to v3.1. No outstanding deploys.

Anika (PM): Thanks — I'll update release notes draft with a note that v3.2 is shelved until we land the cold-KV microfix.

Lee: I'll cherry-pick the microfix and run a quick CI bake tomorrow morning. Will open a short PR and tag for an early-morning reattempt.

Matt (oncall): Good call to abort. We'll leave Dedicated pinned to v3.1 until we verify the fix in a staging sweep.

Sam G: Appreciate the rapid decisions. Follow-ups: Lee pls post the PR link; Anika pls update the release doc. We'll re-schedule the rollout only after a telemetry sign-off. :thumbsup:
